generated.details: On the middle-right tabletop beside the laptop, the unlabelled fabric swatches are loose overlapping neutral woven rectangles with thin, slightly frayed edges.
Immediately farther right, the geometric foam mock-up pieces are small cream blocks and wedges with flat cut faces, fine cellular texture and stable bases.
Behind the materials at rear-right, the studio task lamp has a weighted metal base, two hinged arms and a shallow shade tilted down over them.
